coordinates.marker_direction: Marker local +Y points toward vehicle front (-Y world). All positions/axes below are Blender root coordinates.

field_descriptions.pivot_m: Object origin XYZ in metres, rest pose.
field_descriptions.motion: Positive angle uses right-hand rule around signed axis; rest=0 deg.
field_descriptions.axis: Unit rotation axis in Blender root coordinates; null for blinking lights.
field_descriptions.range_deg: Mechanical min/max angle; null means continuous spin or no mechanical motion.
field_descriptions.markers: Empty position, local +Y heading and rest Euler rotation in Blender coordinates.
field_descriptions.palette_samples: 5x5 median at top-left-origin source pixel coordinates; assumed colors explicitly labelled.
field_descriptions.measurement: Body envelope excludes mirrors; body height excludes three beacons; ground Z=0.

asset_note: Instantiate this same reusable FBX twice; no duplicated geometry asset.
